title: Punish the Scandinavian Defense
transcript: Okay, the Scandinavian. Of course, this opening violates one of the key uh rules of the opening because now we can already attack the queen in the center and we develop a knight in doing so. So now the queen already has to move somewhere and it moves all the way back and now we can take the full center with our other pawn and we are going to develop the bishop, develop the other bishop, bring the knight out. This knight comes out. We can probably push and remove this knight. Once again, the knight has to move. So, our opponent has already wasted four moves for two pieces. The knight goes to the corner. And as we all know, knights on the rim are dim. This knight is already trapped with B4 like this. There is no square to go back to. And we are up a knight on move seven of the Scandinavian. Nice.
